**Finding: compliant (at fallback) — INDEMN, § 8.**

Section 8.1 already carries a Commerce One indemnity in our favour covering third-party claims that the Software infringes patent, copyright, trademark or trade secret rights, extended to Corio *and its Customers*, with notice, tender of control, and cooperation, plus the full remedy ladder (procure / replace or modify / terminate and pro-rated refund of fees paid). Section 8.2's exclusions are narrower than the fallback permits (only out-of-Documentation use and third-party modification — no combination or specification carve-outs), which favours us. Section 9 excepts Section 8 liability from the fee cap entirely, so the indemnity is uncapped rather than limited to a 3× super-cap — again better than the fallback.

Noted, not redlined: the indemnity is IP-only (no heads for breach of applicable law, Vendor-caused data breach, or gross negligence/wilful misconduct) and defence control sits wholly with Commerce One, so the clause stops short of the preferred position. There is no Corio-side indemnity anywhere in the Agreement, so the one-way-indemnity risk does not arise. No redline proposed.
